fields.note: The linear gap (30.21717 against the paper's 27.53 MPa) is not the mesh, which is converged, and not the load stiffness, which raises the value by 1.70%. It is not the through-thickness discretization either. Two candidates fit. (a) Fig. 4(a) draws the 42.80 mm radius arrow to a point inside the wall, so the reference surface is not stated. Read as the mid-surface radius, it gives 28.076 / 28.061 MPa (+2.0% / +1.8%), closing about 80% of the gap. Read at the foam/outer-face interface, it gives 29.738 / 29.715. (b) E_steel of about 187 GPa closes it (190 GPa gives 27.877, 200 GPa gives 29.049), but Table 1 states 210 GPa. A third candidate, the paper's own discretization (about 2 foam solids through 3.1 mm, 1.04 mm continuum-shell faces, tie constraints), was not tested.

qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma.
